[SWS_DM_01379] SOVD mode control_dtc_setting set value
⌈
The
SOVD
method
Explicit Control of Entity States via Their Defined
Modes of SOVD mode control_dtc_setting with valid value in the request body
shall be processed analog to Service Service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) of ISO 14229-
1[1].
⌋
